name: weather-snow
comment: updateWeather's toggles and re-draws and the snow roll's biome test (World.java:1792-1859, :1933-1950). A standing player on a stone platform over chunks (61,-13) and (62,-13), where seed 123's biomes are Taiga (getEnableSnow) on most columns and rainy (Forest, Swampland: 81 of 512 columns) on the west/north corner. set_weather at t=0 makes rain start at t=19 and thunder at t=29, each re-drawn the next tick from the raining/thundering branch (12000+nextInt(12000), 3600+nextInt(12000)); at t=300 both timers are cut so rain stops at t=302 and thunder at t=304, re-drawn from the dry branch (12000+nextInt(168000)). Once getRainStrength > 0.2, the snow roll places snow (78) on the snowy columns only. weather and rng_state every tick, the platform and the layer above it at t=150 and the end. No glowstone (snow and ice updateTick melt only above block light 11, not transcribed; recorded). No entity_state: the player's own update (WP-2.5) is not transcribed.
